name: Data sufficiency
rule: n >= 300 settled picks before forecast validation is even attempted
note: Nfl-lines walk-forward set (n=4,055 games) supplies settlements

name: Walk-forward only
rule: no lookahead: each forecast uses only data available before kickoff
note: pre-registered in nfl-lines model_params.json before first run (peer log 2026-11-02/12)

name: Prices at settlement time
rule: settlement uses closing prices, never snapshot prices
note: closing prices exist for all 137 settled 2026 games; opening prices missing weeks 1-9 (F-C02)

name: Multiple-testing control
rule: BH-adjusted p-value < 0.05 across the strategy family
current_status: FAIL for all 15 strategies (best BH p = 0.44)
note: no strategy clears the luck barrier yet — this is the honest current state

name: Capacity & limits
rule: max 1 unit per pick until G4 passes; no parlay stacking of correlated legs
note: dependence terms handled in combo pricing (empirical joint probability)

name: Signal/staking separation
rule: leaderboard ranks on signal metrics only (hit-rate z), staking shown separately
note: leaderboard_signal.csv ranked by z_vs_breakeven; staking table cannot alter ranks

name: Reward eligibility
rule: a strategy may earn rewards only after G4+G5 pass
note: stated openly on the leaderboard page

name: DEMONITION GATE 1: skill regression
rule: LIVE strategy demoted to PAPER when rolling 200 settled picks show z_vs_breakeven < 0
note: demotion is automatic; re-promotion requires a fresh G4+G5 pass

name: DEMONITION GATE 2: closing-line value
rule: LIVE strategy demoted when CLV (close minus taken price, settled sample) is negative over >= 50 picks
note: requires open+close per pick — supplied by price_snapshots_2026.csv

name: DEMONITION GATE 3: drawdown
rule: LIVE strategy demoted when flat-stake drawdown exceeds 20 units
note: drawdown computed in staking table only; cannot be hidden by stake sizing

name: DEMONITION GATE 4: data integrity
rule: any strategy whose input feed fails verification is demoted immediately until the feed re-verifies
note: verify.py exit code is the trigger; results feed + price store must both pass
